Name: Snapshot Viewer
Author: hyperddr
Description:
Tired to use the screenshot and switch to another app to view the screenshot? Here comes the in game screenshot viewer!
You can just press Q, the image of the whole map of the current level will appear, you can easily zoom and pan the map.
Press the Q again or Esc to close the map.
No need to open the screenshot folder. Everything is in the game.
Also everytime you enter a new level , it will automatically take a screenshot for you . You can press F2 to disable or enable this.

The key "Q" and "F2" can be configed in the Mods/screenshot/config.json
